H6126G.name: Akkub
H6126G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6126G.brief: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
H6126G.short: Akkub was a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah, listed in the genealogy of the royal line.

H6126H.name: Akkub
H6126H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H6126H.brief: Levite gatekeeper during the post-exilic period
H6126H.short: Akkub was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the Temple during the post-exilic period.

H6126I.name: Akkub
H6126I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6126I.brief: Family head of Temple servants who returned from exile
H6126I.short: Akkub was a family head of the Temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H6126J.name: Akkub
H6126J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6126J.brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
H6126J.short: Akkub was a Levite who assisted Ezra in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading.

H6166B.name: Arad
H6166B.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6166B.short: Arad was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Beriah.

H6134.name: Eker
H6134.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6134.brief: Son of Ram, descendant of Judah
H6134.short: Eker was a son of Ram and descendant of Judah.

H6147H.name: Er
H6147H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6147H.brief: Judah's grandson, ancestor of linen workers.
H6147H.short: Er was Judah's grandson, ancestor of linen workers at Beth-ashbea.

H6147G.name: Er
H6147G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6147G.brief: Judah's firstborn son, killed by God for his wickedness.
H6147G.short: Er, Judah's firstborn son, was killed by God because of his wickedness.

H6197.name: Eran
H6197.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6197.brief: Son of Shuthelah, grandson of Ephraim; head of clan.
H6197.short: Eran was a son of Shuthelah and grandson of Ephraim, who became the head of the Eranite clan.

H6179.name: Eri
H6179.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6179.brief: Son of Gad; head of the Erite clan.
H6179.short: Eri was a son of Gad and the head of the Erite clan.

H6112G.name: Eznites
H6112G.brief: Adino the Eznite; one of David's mighty men.
H6112G.short: Adino the Eznite, also known as Josheb-Basshebeth, was one of David's mighty men who wielded his spear against eight hundred men.

H6142.name: Ikkesh
H6142.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H6142.brief: Father of Ira, one of David's mighty warriors.
H6142.short: Ikkesh the Tekoite was the father of Ira, one of King David's mighty warriors and a leader in his army.

H6159.name: Oreb
H6159.short: Oreb was a Midianite prince who was killed by the Ephraimites during the time of Gideon.

H6144.name: Ar
H6144.short: Ar, the capital of Moab, mentioned in the context of Israel's journey and prophecies.

H6160G.name: Arabah
H6160G.brief: A desert region in the Jordan Valley and southward.
H6160G.short: The Arabah, a desert plain extending from the Sea of Galilee to the Gulf of Aqaba.

H6152B.name: Arabia
H6152B.brief: A region and its inhabitants, mentioned in various contexts.
H6152B.short: Arabia, a desert region southeast of Israel, known for trade and nomadic tribes.

H6166A.name: Arad
H6166A.brief: Arad, Canaanite city, attacked Israel, later inhabited by Kenites
H6166A.short: Arad, a Canaanite city that attacked Israel during their wilderness journey, later inhabited by the Kenites.

H6177I.name: Aroer
H6177I.brief: A city in Judah, receiving spoils from David.
H6177I.short: Aroer, a city in Judah that received a share of the spoils from David's victory over the Amalekites.

H6177H.name: Aroer
H6177H.brief: A city on the edge of the Arnon Valley.
H6177H.short: Aroer, a city situated on the edge of the Arnon Valley, near the border between Israel and Moab.

H6177G.name: Aroer
H6177G.brief: A city in Gad, built by the Gadites.
H6177G.short: Aroer, a city in the territory of Gad, built by the Gadites.

H6111.name: Azmon
H6111.brief: Place on the southern border of Judah.
H6111.short: Azmon was a place on the southern border of Judah.

H6138.name: Ekron
H6138.brief: One of the five major Philistine city-states
H6138.short: Ekron, one of the five principal Philistine cities, located in southwestern Canaan.

H6107.name: Ezem
H6107.brief: City allotted to Judah and Simeon
H6107.short: Ezem, a city allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Negev region.

H6100.name: Ezion-geber
H6100.brief: Israelite encampment; port city on Red Sea
H6100.short: Ezion-geber, an Israelite encampment during the Exodus and later a port city on the Red Sea, known for its maritime trade and shipbuilding.
